about_the_game:
What The Coffin is currently in development, and we’re hard at work making it the wobbliest, most chaotic co-op experience possible! Everything you see is a work in progress and subject to change as we fine-tune the physics, levels, and sheer ridiculousness. Stay tuned for updates as we bring this coffin-carrying adventure to life!

Deliver Kevin To Heaven!

What The Coffin follows the ridiculous journey of Kevin ... who is very much un-alive ... as you and a friend attempt to deliver his coffin to heaven. Working together, you’ll each hold one end of the casket while navigating wild obstacles, tricky climbs, and even discovering hidden gems along the way. Just try not to drop Kevin… he’s been through enough!

Customisable Chaos!

Along the way, you’ll unlock a variety of cosmetics to customise your characters, all earned through gameplay, including:

  • Hats 🎩 – From classy to downright ridiculous!

  • Tops 👕 – Dress up or dress questionably!

  • Trousers 👖 – Because running around in just a top would be weird…

  • Full Outfits 👔 – Go all out with themed sets!

Earn your style as you stumble towards the afterlife!

Coffin-Carrying Champions!

Think you’ve got what it takes to be the best undertaker in the business? Compete with friends and players worldwide on the leaderboards! Race against the clock, keep your coffin steady, and prove you're the ultimate coffin-carrying duo.

  • Fastest Times ⏱️ – Who can ascend to the top the quickest?

  • Flawless Runs 🌟 – Less stumbling, more style!

  • Hidden Collectibles 🎩 – Discover secrets and climb the ranks.

Will you carry Kevin with grace, or will your journey end in disaster? The leaderboards will decide!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 2 Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: In What The Coffin, you and a friend face the wildest challenge: hauling a wobbly corpse through a chaotic world of physics-based obstacles! It’s all about coffin-cooperation. If you drop it, you're both going six feet under! Can your friendship survive the madness?
